fact: A study published on 21 April 2026 assessed seven Sudanese academic, governmental and service websites against WCAG 2.1 AA with WAVE, axe DevTools and Lighthouse, finding Lighthouse scores of 76 to 88 and barriers on all sites such as missing alternative text and poor colour contrast.
title: Digital Accessibility Assessment of Sudanese Websites: A Multi-Tool Evaluation Across Governmental, Academic, and Service Sectors
publisher: Manar Al-Sharq Journal for Education and Educational Technology
